name: VistoureAI Try-On for WooCommerce
author: VistoureAI

sections.description:
This plugin enables fashion and lifestyle WooCommerce stores to integrate a virtual try-on feature on product or cart pages. Easily configurable. No coding required.

External services

This plugin connects to the external service VistoureAI (https://vistoureai.com) to provide the Virtual Try-On functionality.

  • What service is used:
    VistoureAI API (developed and operated by the plugin authors) processes product try-on requests and generates try-on images.

  • What data is sent and when:
    When a user uploads a photo and selects a product to try on, the following information is sent to the VistoureAI API:

    • The uploaded photo (user-provided image).
    • The selected product type/category.
    • The product photo (store-provided image).
    • The plugin’s API key (required for authentication).

    No other personal data is sent automatically.
    User ID or email is never transmitted to VistoureAI by default.

  • Why this data is sent:
    The data is required to generate and return a virtual try-on preview image for the user.

  • Where the data is sent:
    All requests are sent securely via HTTPS to https://vistoureai.com/api/v2/.

  • Service provider:
    VistoureAI (https://vistoureai.com) – This service is owned and maintained by the plugin developers.

  • Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:

    • Terms of Service: https://www.vistoureai.com/terms-of-service
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.vistoureai.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
The easiest way to install this plugin is via your WordPress Dashboard:
1. Install the Virtual Try-On for WooCommerce by VistoureAI either via the WordPress plugin directory or by uploading plugin zip file to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
3. Make sure to create an account in https://vistoureai.com, subscribe to plan and create an API key.
4. Once you have the API key, you can paste it in the settings page of the plugin and verify the tokens remaining.
sections.faq:
Does this require any third-party API?

Yes, this plugin uses VistoureAI API to perform generate try-on images.

Is it compatible with any theme?

Yes, this plugin uses standard WooCommerce hooks.

How does the plugin detect product types?

The plugin automatically infers the product type to ensure compatibility with the try-on API.

The detection follows this priority:
1. Product Tags (highest priority)
2. Product Categories
3. Product Name (fallback)

These values are then normalized into one of the following types for API compatibility:
– dresses → e.g., dresses, dress, gown, frock, lehenga
– tops → e.g., tops, top, kurti, tunic, blouse, shirt
– bottoms → e.g., bottoms, pant, jeans, palazzo, salwar, skirt, trouser, legging

Note: Store owners can control this by editing their product tags or categories for more accurate results.
